m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Wizard! Oh, finally! I'm so tired of being Sparck's Lab Assistant. Please, PLEASE, tell me we have marching orders from the Arcanum!
We're to escort Mellori's dying body to an island called Mandalla? OK, I think I've heard of it! Now, where are Beans and Mellori? Oh...
Here we ar- Aaaah! No no no no no! How do you stop this thing?!?
Ah, whew. OK, here we are! Mellori's vitals remained stable during transit, but she's still on a downward trajectory.
Beans! You look like you're having some trouble there. Be careful, man. That's about as precious a cargo as precious cargo comes.
Darn it, James! I'm a doctor not a deliveryman!
Where's Sparck? We need to get a move on. It takes a surprising amount of core strength to keep this contraption parked.
Beans, my muscleless Medical Officer, you're right. So, the thing with our Science Officer is...
Bartleby says Mellori's consciousness is lost in the Reverie? That's the plane where thoughts and memories coexist! But how do we retrieve her?
You are to escort Mellori to the place where Life and Death converge... a place called, Mandalla, you say?
<ITALICS>MANDALLA</ITALICS>, of course! That's the island where the Life and Death Paradox Chain is moored... in EMPYREA!
Aah, of course it's in Empyrea. At least Sparck and the Captain are already there. But how in the blue blazes do we get into this Reverie place?
I have heard legends tell of the Reverie. I am certain it is akin to the Other Side.
It will take a bit of research, but I can get you there. When the time comes, I will find you.
It's going to take a bit to get Mellori's life support apparatus prepped for travel. You go on ahead, Wizard. We'll catch up with you on Aeriel.
My, oh my, this all has my head spinning. Good luck, Wiz- uh, I mean, Scion. We're all counting on you!
You should go rally Captain Pork and that Sparck fellow while Dr. Beans prepares Mellori for the trip to Mandalla.
